en: To lift something to a higher position; or to improve someone's status or mood.
ex: The new law elevated her status in the company.
新法律提升了她在公司的地位。

en: A scientist who studies chemistry; or (British) a person who prepares and sells medicines.
ex: The chemist mixed the chemicals in the lab.
化學家在實驗室裡混合化學藥品。

en: A person whose job is to take or pay out money in a shop or bank.
ex: The cashier gave me my change and a receipt.
收銀員給了我找零和收據。

en: To ask for information about something; or to find out the facts.
ex: I called to inquire about the price of the room.
我打電話詢問那間房的價格。

en: To happen or exist before something else in time or order.
ex: The speech was preceded by a short film.
演講之前先放映了一部短片。

en: To surprise someone so much they cannot speak or act; or to make someone unconscious.
ex: The news stunned the whole country.
這個消息震驚了全國。

en: The edge of land where it meets the sea; or the shape of the shore.
ex: The road follows the coastline for fifty miles.
這條路沿著海岸線延伸五十英里。

en: An event when the sun or moon is hidden by another body; or to make someone seem less important or successful.
ex: Thousands gathered to watch the solar eclipse.
數以千計的人聚集觀看日蝕。

en: To provide food and drink for an event; or to supply what is needed or wanted.
ex: The company will cater the wedding for two hundred guests.
公司將為兩百名賓客承辦這場婚宴。

en: Working or in use; or very important; also (noun) a skilled worker or a secret agent.
ex: The new rules become operative next month.
新規定將於下個月生效。

en: To make someone feel better when they are sad or disappointed; or a control panel.
ex: She tried to console her friend after the loss.
她在朋友失去親人後試圖安慰他。

en: A piece of paper that gives you a discount or free item when you buy something.
ex: I used a coupon to get ten percent off my order.
我用折價券讓訂單打了九折。

en: A thick, soft cloth with a smooth, short surface on one side; or soft and smooth like this cloth.
ex: She wore a long dress made of black velvet.
她穿著一件黑色天鵝絨長禮服。

en: A platform built next to water where ships stop to load and unload cargo or passengers.
ex: Fishing boats were tied up at the wharf.
漁船停靠在碼頭邊。

en: To help someone return to a normal life after an illness, injury or prison; or to restore something to good condition.
ex: The center helps rehabilitate people with drug problems.
這個中心幫助有毒癮問題的人重返正常生活。

en: The state of being clean and free from harmful substances; or complete moral goodness.
ex: The company is known for the purity of its products.
公司以產品的純度而聞名。

en: To make someone suffer something unpleasant, such as pain, punishment or damage.
ex: The storm inflicted heavy damage on the town.
暴風雨對這個小鎮造成了嚴重損害。

en: Careful in choosing; choosing only the best or most suitable things.
ex: The university is highly selective about its students.
這所大學對學生的挑選極為嚴格。

en: A light ringing sound like small bells; or a short catchy tune used in advertising.
ex: The advertising jingle was stuck in my head all day.
那首廣告歌曲整天在我腦中揮之不去。

en: Relating to the first people to live in a place; or a person from such a group.
ex: The museum displays aboriginal art from Australia.
博物館展示著澳洲原住民的藝術品。

en: Made of clay that is baked until hard; or an object made this way.
ex: She makes beautiful ceramic bowls in her studio.
她在工作室裡製作美麗的陶瓷碗。

en: The treatment of mental illness by talking with a trained person rather than using drugs.
ex: He started psychotherapy to deal with his anxiety.
他開始接受心理治療來應對焦慮。

en: A substance found in coffee, tea and chocolate that makes you feel more awake.
ex: Too much caffeine can keep you awake at night.
攝取太多咖啡因會讓你晚上睡不著。

en: Neat and well organized; or a hospital worker who does general jobs.
ex: The students left the building in an orderly manner.
學生們有秩序地離開了大樓。

en: A distance north or south of the equator, measured in degrees; or freedom to act or think as you wish.
ex: The city lies at forty degrees north latitude.
這座城市位於北緯四十度。

en: To make a person or part of the body unable to move or feel; or to make something unable to operate normally.
ex: The snowstorm paralyzed the whole city.
暴風雪使整座城市陷入癱瘓。

en: Sexually attracted to people of the same sex.
ex: The law protects homosexual people from discrimination.
法律保護同性戀者免受歧視。

en: To ask questions or examine something carefully to find out facts; or a device used to explore or examine.
ex: Reporters probed into the minister's business dealings.
記者們深入調查了部長的商業往來。

en: Having or showing great love for your country.
ex: The crowd sang patriotic songs at the parade.
群眾在遊行中高唱愛國歌曲。

en: To feel angry or bitter about something that you think is unfair.
ex: She resented being treated like a child.
她討厭被當成小孩對待。

en: A layer of material that covers the inside surface of something, such as a coat or box.
ex: Every cloud has a silver lining.
凡事總有光明的一面。

en: Too much pride in your appearance or abilities; or a dressing table with a mirror.
ex: His vanity made him spend hours in front of the mirror.
他的虛榮心使他花好幾個小時照鏡子。

en: A low, deep sound or a man with a low singing voice; or a type of fish.
ex: He plays the bass guitar in a rock band.
他在搖滾樂團裡彈貝斯。

en: To take a quick look at something, especially secretly; or a quick look.
ex: She took a peek at her presents before the party.
她在派對前偷看了她的禮物。

en: To move into a sloping position; or a slope or leaning movement.
ex: She tilted her head and listened carefully.
她歪著頭仔細聽。

en: In the same direction as the hands of a clock move.
ex: Turn the lid clockwise to close the jar.
順時針轉動蓋子以關上罐子。

en: A thin piece of cloth worn over the face or head; or something that hides or covers something else.
ex: The bride wore a long white veil.
新娘戴著一條長長的白面紗。

en: A loss of respect or good reputation because of bad behavior; or to bring shame on someone.
ex: The scandal brought disgrace on his family.
這樁醜聞使他的家族蒙羞。

en: Physical or mental energy and enthusiasm.
ex: He attacked the problem with new vigor.
他以新的活力著手處理這個問題。

en: Cloth or material produced by weaving or knitting; or relating to the making of cloth.
ex: The region is famous for its textile industry.
該地區以其紡織業聞名。
